入门.descZh: 给完全没写过代码的人：先认清 AI 能做什么、不能做什么，再照一条从想法到上线的路线动手。
入门.descEn: For total beginners: what AI can actually do, then a route from idea to a live product.

产品.descZh: 把一个想法做成有人付钱的东西：需求验证、定价获客，每一步都配真实收入数字和亏损复盘。
产品.descEn: Turning an idea into something people pay for: validation, pricing, and acquisition with real numbers.

实战.descZh: 完整走一遍真实项目：零代码做出产品、Demo 改到能上线、用户数据出事后的补救复盘。
实战.descEn: Real projects walked end to end: zero-code build, demo-to-production, and a privacy leak post-mortem.

AI 编程.descZh: 用 AI 写代码的全流程：从第一次打开编辑器，到十万行项目的上下文管理和重构。
AI 编程.descEn: AI coding end to end: first steps in the editor to managing a 100,000-line project's context.

工具评测.descZh: 同一批题目横向实测各家工具，从国产大模型到八款 AI 编程工具，帮你按预算选到合适的那一个。
工具评测.descEn: Hands-on comparisons of AI tools, from Chinese models to eight coding assistants, priced and rated.

AI 技巧.descZh: 怎么把话说清楚让 AI 真听懂：提示词三原则、需求验收清单，以及长文档的正确处理流程。
AI 技巧.descEn: Getting AI to actually understand you: prompting rules, acceptance criteria, and long-document workflows.

Agent.descZh: 从一问一答到让 AI 自己动手：Agent 的四个组件、主流框架怎么选、多角色协作流水线怎么搭。
Agent.descEn: From one-shot answers to agents acting on their own: core parts, framework choices, multi-role pipelines.

独立开发.descZh: 一个人做产品的真实账本：8 个项目的盈亏数据、上线后的运维清单、模型账单怎么才不翻车。
独立开发.descEn: The real ledger of solo building: P&L across eight projects, ops checklists, and runaway model bills.

出海.descZh: 把产品卖给英文用户：怎么用 Reddit 找细分市场、怎么用 AI 处理语言、怎么定美元价格。
出海.descEn: Selling to English-speaking users: finding a niche on Reddit, handling language with AI, pricing in USD.

副业.descZh: 用 AI 赚到第一笔钱的十几条路：每条都写清做什么、用什么工具、多久能赚到多少。
副业.descEn: A dozen ways to earn with AI, each with the work, the tools, and how long it takes to earn.

趋势.descZh: AI 本身在变：从脱口而出的生成模型到想好了再说的推理模型，普通人用法也要跟着换。
趋势.descEn: How AI itself is changing: from instant generation to models that reason first, and how to adapt.

深度解析.descZh: 拆开一次关键发布的技术内幕：强化学习训练为什么让开源模型追平闭源，以及它改变了什么。
深度解析.descEn: Inside one landmark release: why reinforcement learning let an open model match closed ones.

年度总结.descZh: 一年里 AI 真正走到了哪一步：六件大事的时间线，以及普通人从这一变化里拿到什么。
年度总结.descEn: Where AI actually landed this year: six milestones on a timeline and what they changed for you.

视频生成.descZh: 视频生成怎么从演示变成生产力工具：Sora、可灵等关键节点和对创作者的影响。
视频生成.descEn: How video generation became a real tool: Sora, Kling, Runway, and what changes for creators.

AI 绘画.descZh: Midjourney、SD、Flux 怎么选：画质、难度、价格和商用版权问题。
AI 绘画.descEn: Choosing between Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, and Flux on quality, ease, price, and commercial rights.

工具栈.descZh: 一个人做产品要配齐的五套工具：想法验证、设计、编码、上线和运营各该用什么。
工具栈.descEn: The five tool sets a solo builder needs: validation, design, coding, launch, and operations.
